title: Install Python packages from a requirements file
summary: Install all packages listed in a requirements.txt file at once.

steps.explain: Use the --requirement flag to install all packages listed in the specified file.

rollback.explain: There is no single command to undo this. You must manually uninstall the packages that were installed.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of a package to uninstall

warnings: Installing from a requirements file can change many packages at once. Ensure you trust the source of the file.
